title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I've noted down your schedule. You can confirm with me anytime.

title: Talk 1
original: If it's about making someone bleed, do not send Lady Ceylon to the task. Let those who live amongst the shadow take it over, like me.

title: Talk 2
original: I won't tell you anything more about Lady Ceylon. And of course, others won't learn anything more about you from me.

title: Talk 3
original: I'm your bodyguard, Doctor. My duty is to protect you, not chat with you. If you want to talk, please stop turning to me like Lady Ceylon does and find someone else.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: My expertise? Killing targets, guarding people, and... making tea. Don't be so shocked. After all, the tea Lady Ceylon makes is… Anyway, I'm good at that.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Doctor, based on the danger involved in the missions to date, I believe you need to learn self-defense in addition to my protection. Otherwise, even I can't guarantee your safety.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Once you've got blood on your hands, there's no turning back… Doctor, I do not wish you to go down the same road as mine. So leave the dirty works to me.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You want to hear my revenge story? You won't be able to sleep at night, Doctor. But… somehow I do have this strange urge to tell you. Well then, let's hit the bar. This story will take a while.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Sinners always get what they deserve, I know that. But I do wonder sometimes that... if I could have met Lady Ceylon and you sooner, maybe I'd be more than just a killer. It's still not too late for me? Do you really mean that, Doctor?

title: Idle
original: Falls asleep just like that? Can't keep a guard up at all, just like her.

title: Onboard
original: I'm Schwarz, Lady Ceylon's personal bodyguard, here to join Rhodes Island with her. If at all possible, please assign me to accompany her.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I see that Rhodes Island is teeming with war monsters. I can only try to learn their way of battle.

title: Promotion 1
original: Now I understand why Rhodes Island wanted me. Your vision is a hundred times crazier than anything I ever did.

title: Promotion 2
original: Reawaken my memories? I'm fine with it. Maybe you can tame the evil inside us when on battlefields. Please, tame it for us.

title: Added to Squad
original: A mission? Got it

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Follow my orders.

title: Depart
original: Let's go.

title: Begin Operation
original: None will escape.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Where am I needed?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Here.

title: Deployment 1
original: A solid position.

title: Deployment 2
original: They won't get away.

title: In Battle 1
original: I've got you in my sight.

title: In Battle 2
original: Way too obvious.

title: In Battle 3
original: Unworthy of my shots.

title: In Battle 4
original: Lady Ceylon may have mercy. I do not.

title: 4-star Result
original: Doctor, in a dangerous mission like this,  you'd better give you command from as far as possible.

title: 3-star Result
original: We got everyone, per your order.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: The perimeter is secured. What's next?

title: Operation Failure
original: Come, Doctor, I'll ensure your safety.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Patrol? Got it.

title: Tap
original: ...?! Please, Doctor, I don't want you to hurt yourself.

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, I suppose everything's fine?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: New Year's? I only looked forward to New Year's when I was very young, then I lost interest, but... Lady Ceylon enjoys it. I used to escort her home from Victoria at the tail end of the year, and she'd tell me what she'd been up to while away at university. Right, Doctor, you can come have a cup of tea with us later if you are interested.

title: Greeting
original: Don't let your guard down even on base, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Here, it's a birthday present. I was there while Lady Ceylon picked out her present, so I chose some fine dishes for afternoon tea to go with the tea set. When you brew your relaxing tea, you can enjoy some snacks along with it.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Master Doykos helped me to get my revenge, and gave me a new life, while Lady Ceylon taught me to see a warmer, gentler world. I'm also greatly thankful to you all. Rhodes Island lets Lady Ceylon be firm in her goal, and I can be more confidently clear in knowing where my fight is headed.
